script_text: Taurus, your money and love life collide this week, you cannot ignore. Monday through Wednesday, Venus in your 7th House squares Pluto in your 10th House, creating tension in partnerships and power struggles at work you must navigate carefully now. Avoid signing contracts Monday when Mercury squares Neptune, but Wednesday shines for heartfelt love conversations and clear career decisions together. Mid-week, Uranus in your 1st House opposes Venus, suddenly flipping your plans and attraction. Thursday through Sunday, Mars in your 5th House sextiles Saturn in your 11th House, romance while your ruling planet Venus rewards teamwork. Saturday favors dates, Sunday favors budgeting, grounding your earth sign. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 2nd House. Friday is your worst day because Mars squares Uranus in your 1st House. Delay major purchases until Sunday, then invest confidently today. Follow for daily updates.
